verdict.rationale: GitBook has a first-party docs page titled "MCP servers for published docs" under its "AI for your readers" section, so published sites do expose their own MCP server for readers' agents. The evidence is only that page title, though, and says nothing about which tools it offers. The separate GitBook MCP server (create sites, edit pages, open change requests) is an authoring tool for a different story and is not credited here. missing for 10: documented search and page-content retrieval tools, setup and endpoint details for reader agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my published docs site exposes its own MCP server that my users' agents can query for search and page content
